consigna.es: Escucha y elige qué descubre la persona sobre Mia.

items.audio: I called Mia at nine, but she didn't answer. Her brother told me she had already left for work by then, so I sent her a message.
opciones: Mia had gone out before the call.
Mia was still at home when the call came.
Mia left home right after the call.

feedback.es: «Had already left… by then»: Mia ya se había ido antes de la llamada de las nueve.

consigna.es: Escucha y elige qué piensa la persona sobre los vecinos.

items.audio: Their car is still outside, so they can't have gone far. They may have walked to the shop around the corner.
opciones: They have probably travelled a long way.
They are certainly inside the house.
They are probably not far from home.

feedback.es: «Can't have gone far» y «may have walked» deducen que están cerca, no lejos ni seguros en casa.

consigna.es: Escucha y elige quién revisará el calefactor.

items.audio: The heater stopped working yesterday. I'm having an engineer look at it tomorrow morning, and he will send me the bill afterwards.
opciones: The speaker will check it alone.
A professional will check it for the speaker.
The speaker will buy a new one tomorrow.

feedback.es: «I'm having an engineer look at it» (have + algo + verbo): la persona contrata a un técnico, no lo revisa ella.

consigna.es: Escucha y elige qué espera la persona dentro de un año.

items.audio: By the end of the year, I will have saved enough money to buy a small car. This time next year, I will be driving to work.
opciones: The speaker will still be saving up for a car.
The speaker will be looking for a new job nearby.
The speaker will be going to work in a car.

feedback.es: Con «will have saved» y «will be driving» anticipa que ya tendrá ahorros y un coche que usará para trabajar.

consigna.es: Lee el texto y elige qué encontraron al llegar al pueblo.

items.texto: Last Sunday we took Grandma to the village where she grew up. She had promised us the best bread in the country, but when we arrived, the bakery had become a café. The old school had closed years ago, too. Grandma laughed and said she would make the bread herself, as she had done when she was a girl.
opciones: The bakery was now used for something different.
The school had closed only a few days earlier.
Grandma's old house had been sold.

feedback.es: «The bakery had become a café»: el local ya no era panadería; la escuela llevaba años cerrada («years ago»).

consigna.es: Lee el texto y elige qué todavía no ha ocurrido con el pan.

items.texto: In our village, bread is still made in the traditional way. The flour is brought from a farm nearby and mixed by hand. After that, the dough is left to rest for two hours, and then it is baked in a big oven. The bread has been sold in the local market for forty years, and it will soon be sent to other shops in the region.
opciones: It has been sold in the village market.
It is baked in a big oven.
It has reached other shops in the region.

feedback.es: «Will soon be sent» es futuro: aún no llega a otras tiendas. Lo otro ya ocurre o ya ocurrió («is baked», «has been sold»).

consigna.es: Lee el mensaje y elige por qué Sam debe llamar antes de las seis.

items.texto: Hi Sam, Carla phoned at four. She asked whether you had booked the tickets, and I told her you were still waiting for an email. She said you should call her before six because she is leaving for the airport after that. Can you ring her, please? Dad
opciones: The tickets will stop being available at six.
Carla will be travelling after that time.
Dad will need to use the phone then.

feedback.es: Carla dijo que después de las seis sale hacia el aeropuerto, así que luego no podrá hablar con calma.

consigna.es: Lee la noticia y elige la frase que resume bien la situación.

items.texto: Local news: A fire started at the old workshop on Tuesday night. According to the police, nobody was hurt, although two streets were closed for hours. It seems that the fire was caused by an electrical problem, but this has not been confirmed. The workshop owner has not yet answered any questions.
opciones: The police say nobody was hurt, but the cause is unclear.
Everyone agrees that an electrical problem caused the fire last night.
The owner has told reporters there was no electrical problem at all.

feedback.es: Atribuido a la policía: nadie herido. La causa eléctrica es solo una sospecha («It seems… not been confirmed») y el dueño aún no habló.

consigna.es: Elige la forma verbal que completa la frase sobre el pasado.

items.texto: I didn't recognise him because he ___ a lot since our last meeting.
opciones: changed
has changed
had changed

feedback.es: El cambio es anterior al momento pasado de «didn't recognise» y dura desde «since»: pide past perfect, «had changed».

consigna.es: Completa la frase sobre un pasado imaginado.

items.texto: If I had known about the traffic, I ___ home earlier.
opciones: would have left
would leave
had left

feedback.es: Para imaginar un resultado distinto en el pasado se usa if + past perfect y would have + participio.

consigna.es: Elige la palabra relativa que completa la frase.

items.texto: My neighbour, ___ dog is very noisy at night, is moving to another town.
opciones: who
whose
which

feedback.es: «Whose» indica posesión: el perro del vecino. Who o which no pueden ir delante de «dog».

consigna.es: Elige la question tag correcta para cerrar la frase.

opciones: have you
haven't you
did you

feedback.es: La frase es negativa, así que la tag es afirmativa y repite el auxiliar: «have you?».

consigna.es: Elige el conector que completa el mensaje.

items.texto: The road was closed. ___, we arrived an hour late.
opciones: However
In addition
As a result

feedback.es: La segunda frase es consecuencia de la primera: «As a result» introduce el resultado.

consigna.es: Elige la palabra que va con la frase deportiva.

items.texto: She trained for years and finally broke the school ___ in the 100 metres.
opciones: goal
record
team

feedback.es: La combinación natural es «break a record»: superar la mejor marca existente.

consigna.es: Elige la palabra que completa la frase.

items.texto: Everyone trusts Nina because of her ___.
opciones: honesty
honestly
honest

feedback.es: Después de «her» hace falta un sustantivo: «honesty» (de honest + -y); honest es adjetivo.

consigna.es: Elige la palabra que matiza la noticia.

items.texto: ___, the concert has been cancelled, but I haven't seen an official announcement.
opciones: Definitely
Officially
Apparently

feedback.es: «Apparently» presenta algo que se oyó pero no está confirmado; las otras dos expresan certeza oficial o total.

consigna.es: Escribe 2 frases sobre algo que hacías de niño y algo que ya no haces.

items.respuesta: When I was a child, I used to play football with my cousins every afternoon. I don't play any more, but now I watch the matches on television.
aceptadas: As a kid, I used to walk to school with my brother. Today I go by bus because it is far from our house.

feedback.es: Usa «used to» para el hábito pasado y un contraste con el presente (now, today, I don't).

consigna.es: Escribe 2-3 frases: llegaste tarde y qué habría pasado si hubieras salido antes.

items.respuesta: Yesterday I was late for my appointment because I missed the bus. If I had left home earlier, I would have caught it. I would have arrived on time.
aceptadas: I was late to the meeting. If I had got up earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train. I would have arrived on time.

feedback.es: Combina if + past perfect con would have + participio para imaginar un pasado distinto.

notes: P1 discriminación: lectura.2 (ya no es solo secuencia; exige distinguir pasiva presente/perfecta/futura), escucha.1/2/3, lectura.1/3/4 y gramatica.1 subidos de N3 a N4 (past perfect con since, can't have, have + algo + hecho, resumen con atribución).
P1 clave/pistas: escucha.3 ya no se resuelve por eco de 'shop'; vocabulario.4 sin distractores sinónimos; escucha.4 opciones de igual longitud.
P1 rúbricas de escritura: grupos ampliados con variantes naturales; escritura.2 ya no exige una frase concreta de 'antes'.
P2: posiciones de la clave redistribuidas (0/1/2).
